recommendation: AUDIT CONDITIONAL PASS — SPECIFIC REMEDIATIONS REQUIRED
scope: experimental candidate and prospective integration only; installed production excluded
tests_executed_in_this_audit: candidate source path and compiler flag static inspection

findings.mechanism: Native HTTP context preflight protects 65536 CPU KV tokens, not proposed 32768 GPU-only release envelope; resource admission thresholds are in benchmark controllers, not enforced in generic HTTP serving.
findings.impact: Unsupported long CPU fallback and unbounded release-facing memory/performance promises can pass request admission.
findings.static_check: Inspect CPU g_kv_seq_len, compiled GPU_KV_SEQ, HTTP context_preflight and external runner admission; compare 32768/32769 policy.
findings.runtime_test: NOT RUN: isolated release binary request with logical prompt+max output 32768 then 32769; assert explicitly configured GPU-only policy.
findings.fix: Introduce approved configurable GPU-only 32768 context+reserved-output policy and measurable service-level memory/admission/overload guard; preserve optional CPU fallback for other modes.

findings.mechanism: 32K scalar warm process is incomplete and a fresh retry was blocked by safe GPU admission. Mask63 32K complete n=1 warm 5084.331s versus 3145.699s ordinary N128; timing control is not numerical release alternative.
findings.impact: No qualified release-time latency/SLO under matched environment. Difference is 61.628% on exploratory n=1 samples, confounded by host and expert staging.
findings.static_check: Inspect completed_trials, interrupted original status, split-phase exclusion and performance_review latest_admission; do not relabel partial scalar cold as full process.
findings.runtime_test: NOT RUN: optional same-process 32768 scalar cold+warm subject to existing GPU/host guards and explicit authorization.
findings.fix: Architect set minimum acceptable latency for restricted release; either collect bounded missing cohort if necessary or explicitly retain uncertainty for separately authorized conditional canary.

findings.mechanism: Observed checkout/source and previously recorded binary/shader hashes are not authenticated current installed-service source or process-manager identity. Release plan cannot name safe stop/start/restore procedures.
findings.impact: Unsafe deployment/rollback unless launch ownership, binary and shader provenance, entire cache and environment are established later.
findings.static_check: Compare release procedure's explicit unknown-PID/service-manager statements with handoff and candidate data.
findings.runtime_test: NOT RUN BY DESIGN: production service inspection forbidden in audit.
findings.fix: Future operator verify actual executable/PID/service ownership, launcher argv/env, source/shader hashes, cache/backups and complete reversible runbook under distinct approval.

findings.mechanism: Native handler recognizes budget fields and reasoning_effort=off but ignores enable_thinking and none/low/medium/high. Numeric budget 0 means unlimited.
findings.impact: Requested client controls may silently alter prompt rendering and incompatible expectations; not automatically mask63 math corruption.
findings.static_check: Read request-resolution source and characterized 53 cases; real compiled source characterization is reported by Work B.
findings.runtime_test: NOT RUN: explicit conflicting controls over isolated HTTP with identity/state checks.
findings.fix: Define contract and reject or normalize unsupported controls; gate the feature if promised.

findings.mechanism: 44/44 adapter tests and wire fixtures passed, but actual LM Studio service/GUI and MCP Gateway registry, pagination and dispatch were not validated on this qualified branch. Responses API is not implemented.
findings.impact: Cannot claim deployed GUI/Gateway/Responses compatibility as part of release.
findings.static_check: Compare Work B reported installed_lmstudio_service=unreachable, GUI=NOT RUN, MCP fixtures only, model_inference=false against source contract.
findings.runtime_test: NOT RUN: isolated real LM Studio GUI and authorized actual Gateway scenarios.
findings.fix: Exclude absent optional integrations from release or test actual services with verified endpoint/schema identity.

findings.mechanism: Sanitized summary self-consistent and source verifier strict, but original private binary, manifests/fixtures/raw logs were not independently read or hashed by auditor.
findings.impact: Release authorization should not misrepresent this review as full original-execution attestation.
findings.static_check: Independently checked 256 exact ordered endpoints, all state/hidden/logit/greedy/digest/KV/finite criteria, candidate GPU routing at six boundaries, manifest and binary identifier equality.
findings.runtime_test: NOT RUN: original private raw provenance rehash.
findings.fix: Independent read-only artifact verification at authorization, preserving private data off public GitHub.

findings.mechanism: Nonwhitespace text following first native tool call invalidates/recover model output; answer->tool->answer is not supported as seamless structured result.
findings.impact: Optional unsupported output ordering; cannot claim full general-purpose agent tool composability.
findings.static_check: Native tool_suffix_nonspace and recovery branch behavior.
findings.runtime_test: NOT RUN: forced output token sequence testing.
findings.fix: Document limited ordering or independently qualify a richer tool protocol.

findings.mechanism: Selective mode hash omits compile-time GPU_KV_SEQ, but currently persisted profile prefix cap=8192 <= every supported GPU attention window.
findings.impact: Not a present defect; possible unsafe alias under future prefix-cap or backend changes.
findings.static_check: Compare hash inputs, compiled GPU 8192/16384/32768 and native 8192 prefix cap.
findings.fix: Add selective backend/window identity when supported persisted states can cross backend boundary; avoid whole-executable hashing.

findings.mechanism: At matched 16384 prefix, linear expert staging changed 49.686s to 747.928s while rowwise attention was 52.197s vs 54.656s; cache/page/memory/other load are possible causes, not proven.
findings.impact: Confounds release latency estimates; no demonstrated kernel numerical defect.
findings.static_check: Compare phase counters and environmental observations; note host-wall measurements overlap.
findings.runtime_test: NOT RUN: low-impact I/O/cache residency profiling after release blockers.
findings.fix: Separate page-cache, SSD read, memory pressure and scheduler attribution without altering unrelated applications.
